title: Asymptotic profiles for solutions to the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in the critical Fourier-Herz spaces
summary: We consider the large time asymptotic behavior of solutions to the initial value problem for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in the whole space $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d\ge 2$). When the initial velocity belongs to $L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)$, it is well-known that its spatial integral vanishes as a consequence of the divergence-free compatibility condition. Taking this property into account, Carpio (1996) and Fujigaki-Miyakawa (2001) derived higher-order asymptotic formulas for the strong solutions.
